verdict.rationale: ElevenLabs Agents documents its own retention settings for conversation transcripts and audio recordings. The default 2-year retention period can be changed, which gives first-party control over how long data is kept. Explicit deletion controls are not documented, and the allowed retention values are cut off in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented on-demand deletion of conversations/audio (dashboard or API), the full list of configurable retention periods (e.g. zero retention), API/MCP control of retention, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
